definitions.explanation: A ship designed primarily for transporting goods and materials rather than passengers.

examples.japanese: {貨物船|かもつせん}が{港|みなと}に{入|はい}った。
examples.english: A cargo ship entered the port.

examples.japanese: {大型|おおがた}の{貨物船|かもつせん}が{荷物|にもつ}を{運|はこ}んでいる。
examples.english: A large cargo ship is carrying freight.

examples.japanese: その{貨物船|かもつせん}は{中国|ちゅうごく}から{日本|にほん}へコンテナを{運|はこ}ぶ{定期|ていき}{航路|こうろ}を{走|はし}っている。
examples.english: That cargo ship runs a regular route carrying containers from China to Japan.

notes:
Composed of {貨物|かもつ} (cargo, freight) + {船|せん} (ship, vessel). Japan, as an island nation, depends heavily on maritime shipping, making this a commonly encountered word in news and daily life.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大型|おおがた}{貨物船|かもつせん} — large cargo ship
- コンテナ{貨物船|かもつせん} — container ship
- {貨物船|かもつせん}の{入港|にゅうこう} — entry of a cargo ship into port
- {貨物船|かもつせん}の{事故|じこ} — cargo ship accident

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {客船|きゃくせん} — passenger ship
- タンカー — tanker (ship for transporting liquid cargo)
- {漁船|ぎょせん} — fishing boat
- {輸送船|ゆそうせん} — transport ship (slightly more formal/military nuance)
